skills.name: canvas-design
skills.purpose: Creates original visual art, posters and static designs as .png/.pdf by first writing a design philosophy, then rendering it with code.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'make a poster / piece of art / static design'. No API key.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~113k installs; aitmpl 10.2k downloads; smithery verified; travisvn + ComposioHQ lists

skills.name: brand-guidelines
skills.purpose: Applies brand colors and typography (Anthropic's, as a template to swap for your own) to any artifact.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers when brand colors / style guidelines apply; fork and edit the values for your brand.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~99k installs and on skills.sh 'hot' list (Oct 2026); aitmpl ~1k downloads

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.purpose: Toolkit of 10 preset color/font themes (or on-the-fly themes) to style slides, docs, landing pages and other artifacts.
skills.how_to_use: Invoke when styling any artifact with a consistent theme.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh ~89k installs; aitmpl 3.6k downloads

skills.name: banner-design
skills.purpose: Designs banners for social media, ads, website heroes and print with multiple art-direction options (22 styles) and platform sizes.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'design/create a banner'; optionally uses an image model (Gemini etc.) for visuals.
skills.evidence: 132k-star repo; skills.sh ~31k installs; top result on skillsmp

skills.name: design
skills.purpose: Comprehensive design skill: brand identity, design tokens, logo generation (55 styles), corporate identity mockups, banners, icons (SVG) and social images.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on brand/logo/banner/icon/social-image design requests; AI logo/icon generation needs a Gemini or similar key.
skills.evidence: 132k-star repo; skills.sh ~32.5k installs; skillsmp top result

skills.name: brandkit
skills.purpose: Generates premium brand-kit boards: brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks and visual-world presentations across many aesthetics.
skills.how_to_use: Use for brand identity visuals; requires an image-generation tool (GPT Image / Nano Banana).
skills.notes: Install numbers look inflated but repo is genuinely popular.

skills.name: baoyu-cover-image
skills.purpose: Generates article/social cover images along 5 dimensions (type, palette, rendering, text, mood) in 2.35:1, 16:9 or 1:1.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'generate cover image'; uses baoyu-image-gen providers (API key needed).

skills.name: baoyu-infographic
skills.purpose: Generates publication-ready infographics with 21 layouts x 22 visual styles, recommending combinations from the content.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'infographic' / 'visual summary'; needs an image-gen API key.
skills.evidence: 26k-star repo; skills.sh ~32.3k installs; also bundled in Hermes Agent

skills.name: higgsfield-brandkit
skills.purpose: Builds full visual brand systems via Higgsfield: palettes, SVG logo marks, typography, mockups, social graphics, posters, packaging and PPTX/PDF brandbooks.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on brand-kit/brandbook requests; needs Higgsfield CLI + account (paid credits).
skills.evidence: Official Higgsfield; skills.sh ~72.6k installs; repo created Apr 2026 now 1.2k stars

skills.name: higgsfield-youtube-thumbnail
skills.purpose: Creates high-CTR YouTube thumbnails and vertical covers: information-gap concept, up to 3 referenced identities, logos, variants (Nano Banana Pro + Seedream edits).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'make a YouTube thumbnail'; needs Higgsfield CLI + account.

skills.name: canva-resize-for-social-media
skills.purpose: Canva's official skill to resize one Canva design into multiple social formats (Facebook/Instagram post & story, LinkedIn) in one go.
skills.how_to_use: Requires the Canva MCP connector / Canva account; triggers on resize-for-social requests.
skills.notes: Same plugin ships bulk-create, brand-check, edit-design, get-design-feedback.

skills.name: canva-bulk-create
skills.purpose: Bulk-creates Canva designs from CSV/tabular data using a brand template with autofill fields (one design per row).
skills.how_to_use: Requires Canva MCP connector and a brand template (Canva Enterprise/Teams autofill).

skills.name: visual-design-foundations
skills.purpose: Applies typography, color theory, spacing systems and iconography principles to build cohesive visual systems and style guides.
skills.how_to_use: Use when establishing design tokens, style guides or fixing visual hierarchy. No API key.

skills.name: logo-creator
skills.purpose: Logo design via AI image generation: discuss style/ratio, generate variations, iterate, crop, remove background and export to SVG.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on logo/icon/favicon/mascot requests; has scripts and templates; needs an image-gen API key (Gemini).

skills.name: banner-creator
skills.purpose: Banner/header/cover creation via AI image generation with format/style discussion, variations, feedback loop and crop to target ratio.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on banner, hero image, GitHub/Twitter header requests; needs Gemini API key.

skills.name: magazine-poster
skills.purpose: Editorial newsprint-style poster template: dateline, oversized serif headline with struck word, two-column body, numbered sections and pull-quotes.
skills.how_to_use: Use for 'magazine/editorial poster' briefs; built for the Open Design app, sibling image-poster template does single-image key art.

skills.name: logo-design
skills.purpose: Professional logo design from brief to production files: mark-type selection, clean geometric SVG logos, optical refinement, testing at 16px/one-colour, presentation.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on logo/brand-mark requests; no API key (SVG output).
skills.evidence: Repo created 26 Sep 2026 and already ~1.5k stars (fast-rising)

skills.name: latex-posters
skills.purpose: Creates research/conference posters in LaTeX (beamerposter, tikzposter, baposter) with typography, figures and PDF preflight.
skills.how_to_use: Use for academic posters; needs a LaTeX install.
skills.notes: Sibling pptx-posters builds editable PowerPoint posters.

skills.name: web-asset-generator
skills.purpose: Generates favicons, PWA app icons and Open Graph/social share images from logos or text, with correct HTML meta tags.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on favicon/OG image requests; Python + Pillow.
skills.evidence: Listed in travisvn and hesreallyhim awesome lists; skills.sh ~860 installs

skills.name: youtube-thumbnail
skills.purpose: Turns a video title into a branded YouTube thumbnail concept using a creator reference photo, high-CTR principles and brand colours (prompt for Gemini).
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'thumbnail'; needs a Gemini image tool to render.

skills.name: SVG Logo Designer
skills.purpose: Creates SVG logos from descriptions with multiple layout/style variations, exportable to PNG.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on logo/brand mark requests; no key.

skills.name: logo-generator
skills.purpose: Generates SVG logos plus high-end showcase images on multiple backgrounds; iterates on concepts.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on logo requests; showcase images need an image API.
